name: Mama to no Amai Seikatsu II
source:
Hikari's mother passed away when he was ten years old.  His father is in charge of on-site management at a newly built apartment building and does not come home much.  

One day, Hikari's father introduces him to his new stepmother.  She's fewer than ten years older than Hikari, so Hikari doesn't even call her "mom", he calls her "Kaori-san".  She really wants to be called "Mama", so she does her best to take care of Hikari, but...

One evening, Papa was away as usual, and a television special about hypnosis was being aired.  Hikari and his stepmother decide to give it a try, and he starts to feel unfamiliar emotions while playing naughty hypnosis pranks...
translation:
光的母亲在他十岁时去世了。他的父亲在一栋新建的公寓楼负责现场管理，不常回家。

有一天，光的父亲把他介绍给他的新继母。她比光大不到十岁，所以光甚至不叫她“妈妈”，而是叫她“香织桑”。她很想被称为“妈妈”，所以她竭尽全力照顾Hikari，但是……

一天晚上，爸爸像往常一样不在，正在播放一档关于催眠的电视特别节目。光和他的继母决定尝试一下，他在玩顽皮的催眠恶作剧时开始感受到陌生的情绪……
